Hanzo gains 25 Demon Blood and sends out the demon (Hanekage) in the target direction while gaining a new set of skills.
(Hanekage) consumes 10 (Demon Blood) every second while he is out. Hanzo's body will be slowly pulled to Hanekage's location as Demon Blood depletes. (Hanekage) can move through terrain and gains 35% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed, but his Physical & Magic Defense are reduced by 50.0%.
If (Hanekage) is killed, he will be drawn back to Hanzo's body, stunning Hanzo for 3s and weakening him for 8s (slowing him by 55%, reducing his Physical & Magic Defense by 100%, and revealing his location to enemies). (Use Again): Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body (the additional skill button will summon Hanzo's body to Hanekage instead).
Try to hide Hanzo's body in the safe area. When facing Hanzo, to find his body and kill him is also a good way to counter him.

When units die near Hanzo, the demon Hanekage absorbs their souls and converts them into (Demon Blood).\nHanzo gains 2 (Demon Blood) for each non-hero unit and 20 (Demon Blood) for each hero that dies in his vicinity.
Even when Hanzo is in a defensive status, he can also recover Demon Blood depending on his Passive. The sufficiency of Demon Blood is a must for Hanzo to perform attack or escape.
